sourceNotice: Six ProductId branches were identified in the supplied SuryodayWeb React UI. This site catalogs controls visible in inspected UI components. Server-side rules, lookup values and complete approved Suryoday policy schedules were not supplied. SuryodayaBank ASP.NET sources contain mixed Suryoday and ESAF references; confirm the production baseline before treating legacy pages as authoritative.
deliveryTarget: Management target in supplied brief: implementation and testing by 31 December 2026; OPTIM ready to replace APPX from 1 January 2027.

stages.title: Login and authentication
stages.detail: APPX exposes ProHorizon credential login and an ADID route/callback. OPTIM screenshots show username, password, arithmetic captcha, then six-digit OTP. Confirm target authentication policy.

stages.title: Dashboard
stages.detail: Dashboard uses date, product and month filters. Queue/widgets are role and API driven.

stages.title: Lead creation and sourcing
stages.detail: Sourcing fields include channel, employee code, state, district, source name, disbursement branch and product. Geography/channel lookups depend on user and location.

stages.title: Mobile and OTP verification
stages.detail: Member mobile verification screen. OTP service rules and expiry/retry are not present in supplied client source.

stages.title: Applicant and member selection
stages.detail: Member type values in source are Co-Applicant and Guarantor. Skip Add Member is shown only when DEStatus=3 and posts Mode=23, CLOSED, DONE.

stages.title: Applicant identity and details
stages.detail: Applicant entity, POI/POA, name, DOB, gender, PAN and loan amount fields. Many values are prefilled or disabled.

stages.title: KYC and identity verification
stages.detail: Aadhaar/VID and OTP controls are visible in code. Provider contracts, consent and exception handling require confirmation.

stages.title: Dedupe
stages.detail: Vault dedupe component is present. Match keys, outcomes and override policy are service-owned and unavailable.

stages.title: Product and scheme sourcing
stages.detail: ProductId selects one of six product-specific forms. Scheme, Policy, Funding Type, Customer Grade and dealer lookups are dynamic.

stages.title: Asset details
stages.detail: Used products have separate asset screens. New asset fields are included in their product loan form. Use the product-specific field list.

stages.title: Loan details
stages.detail: Fields are rendered from the product-specific form. Effective pricing, amount limits, term and LTV schedules are API/master driven.

stages.title: Scorecard and credit inputs
stages.detail: Score Type and dynamic controls are fetched from API. Question definitions and scoring values are not in source.

stages.title: Fleet and asset grouping
stages.detail: Fleet components exist; applicability must be confirmed from product journey configuration.

stages.title: Viability
stages.detail: Viability type is configurable/API driven. Applicability and rules require confirmation.

stages.title: Application form personal details
stages.detail: Personal, relationship, contact, education, residency, marital status, dependents, income and communication fields.

stages.title: Application form address details
stages.detail: Current/permanent address, accommodation/residence, rent and address-duration fields. Current address fields are disabled in the source form.

stages.title: Employment and business details
stages.detail: Udyam, occupation, business/industry, office location, contact and experience fields.

stages.title: References and nominee
stages.detail: Two references and nominee identity/address fields are represented.

stages.title: Charges and insurance
stages.detail: Sanction, ROI, CLI/Hospi, processing, valuation, eSign, stamp and document charges. Most values are calculated or API/master driven.

stages.title: Bank account verification
stages.detail: Repayment account, customer name, IFSC, account and PDC fields. IFSC and bank-status service calls are present.

stages.title: Documents, request and RCU
stages.detail: Upload, request, view and RCU components exist. The exact document matrix and service fields are not fully represented as labelled controls.

stages.title: Sanction and multi-loan summary
stages.detail: Sanction-letter and multi-loan modules exist; exact policy fields and approval outputs require bank confirmation.

stages.title: Disbursement details
stages.detail: Dealer/payee, district, outlet, proforma invoice, account, IFSC and balance-transfer fields.

stages.title: Repayment setup and NACH
stages.detail: Static NACH choices in source: Physical NACH, E-Nach and SI.

stages.title: Approval queues and workflow
stages.detail: LeadJourney receives MenuName, status, active and visibility from GetJourney. Legacy pages indicate credit, deviation, QC/audit and approval modules; active stage names, roles and transitions need an approved workflow export.

lead/LoanNewCarLoanForm.js.name: appliedLoanAmount
lead/LoanNewCarLoanForm.js.label: Applied Loan Amount (LTV On Road Price : %) (LTV Total Asset Cost : %)

workflowMenu.detail: Sourcing Details; conditional Asset Details; Loan Details
Charges route; journey UI also prints POST DISBURSEMENT STAGE before MenuID 8, so ordering/name conflict requires confirmation

policyAreas.name: Age and applicant eligibility
policyAreas.detail: No approved age thresholds or customer-category rules in supplied sources.

policyAreas.name: Income and customer category
policyAreas.detail: Monthly Income field exists in the application form; acceptable income sources and thresholds are not supplied.

policyAreas.name: Loan amount, tenure and rate
policyAreas.detail: Forms show dynamic term, ROI and amount fields; effective product/scheme limits and rate tables are API/master-driven.

policyAreas.name: LTV and asset valuation
policyAreas.detail: New car labels show LTV percentages dynamically; used asset forms use grid/valuation fields. Approved limits and grids are not supplied.

policyAreas.name: CLI coverage
policyAreas.status: UI rule observed; bank approval required
policyAreas.detail: Frontend uses a minimum coverage of ₹100,000 for ProductId 2 and 7 and ₹300,000 for ProductId >7, with maximum equal to loan availed. Validate current policy and boundary behavior with Suryoday.

policyAreas.name: Charges and taxes
policyAreas.detail: Processing, document, GST, stamp, valuation, CLI and Hospi fields/calculations are represented; charge masters and signed values are absent.

policyAreas.name: Bureau, scorecard and dedupe
policyAreas.detail: Dynamic scorecard, bureau and dedupe modules exist; thresholds, responses and override authorities are absent.

policyAreas.name: Documents and KYC
policyAreas.detail: KYC and upload modules exist; product/member/stage mandatory document matrix and provider contracts are absent.

policyAreas.name: Deviation and approval
policyAreas.detail: Legacy page names indicate deviation/approval/QC surfaces; active rules, authorities and roles are not verified.

policyAreas.name: Disbursement
policyAreas.detail: Dealer, payee, account, IFSC, NACH and balance transfer controls exist; payout limits, approval rules and host contracts are absent.

integrations.name: Masters
integrations.detail: Product, scheme, state, district, branch, channel and other dynamic options.

integrations.name: Journey and lead
integrations.detail: Dynamic stage menu/status, case data and stage transition.

integrations.name: Applicant / KYC / documents
integrations.detail: Mobile validation, applicant KYC and uploads; full contracts unavailable.

integrations.name: Bank account
integrations.detail: IFSC lookup and bank account verification.

integrations.name: Charges / disbursement
integrations.paths: Charge and api/Disbursement calls in component source
integrations.detail: Pricing and payout details are server-owned; complete endpoint/payload inventory required.
